---
name: brs-analysis
description: "Extract requirements and stories from a BRS."
---
# Procedure

Preserve source section/page references. Separate functional, nonfunctional, security, data and integration requirements. Identify actors, rules, exclusions, constraints and contradictions. Create traceable stories with Given/When/Then criteria. Keep unknown rules as blocking questions. Use harness/templates/requirements.json and stories.json; do not fill unanswered fields with guesses.

# Contract

Read docs/STACK.md and the selected change inputs. Preserve source/requirement references. Persist outputs to changes/CHANGE-ID. Use templates where relevant. Do not modify controls or self-approve. Report blockers with the decision needed and affected artifacts.
